blocks.text: Archived Apple note state

Internet Archive preserved Apple's iOS 26.4 beta documentation during the interval after Beta 1 and before Beta 2. The raw DocC payload identifies itself as the 26.4 beta notes and contains 12 structured items represented here.

citations.locator: Human DocC capture 20260219170414; companion raw payload 20260219063222; iOS & iPadOS 26.4 Beta Release Notes

blocks.text: Documented Beta 1 inventory

The archived state covers Background Assets APIs and limitations, memory protection, RCS encryption testing, networking, StoreKit, SwiftUI, UIKit, Feedback, external media, and Reality Composer. Items are separated below so known issues, resolved issues, new APIs, and test-only capabilities remain distinguishable.

This page records the first retained 26.4 note state, not a claim that every item debuted at the exact seed publication time. The raw capture predates Beta 2, which makes Beta 1 the only intervening 26.4 milestone; later beta, RC, and Public material is not copied backward.

changes.title: Offline Background Assets inspection and refresh APIs
changes.canonicalSummary: Background Assets added APIs for inspecting local asset-pack state while offline and requesting the latest locally available pack version.
changes.summary: The initial archived beta note documents offline status queries and an API for ensuring that the latest asset-pack version is available locally.
changes.verificationMethod: Observed in the first CDX-confirmed raw Apple DocC payload after Beta 1 and before Beta 2. This is initial snapshot-state attribution, not a claim about the exact hour the item first appeared.

citations.locator: Background Assets — New Features; issues 164498466 and 166237389

changes.title: Background Assets download-crash known issue
changes.canonicalSummary: Apple documented a beta issue in which an application could crash while downloading an asset pack.
changes.summary: The beta note warns that an asset-pack download could crash the application and provides relaunch guidance.
changes.verificationMethod: Observed in the first CDX-confirmed raw Apple DocC payload after Beta 1 and before Beta 2. This is initial snapshot-state attribution, not a claim about the exact hour the item first appeared.

changes.title: External HFS automount known issue
changes.canonicalSummary: Apple documented that HFS-formatted external media might not mount automatically in the beta.
changes.summary: The shared iOS and iPadOS beta note records an automatic-mount failure for HFS external media and labels its command-line workaround as macOS-only.
changes.verificationMethod: Observed in the first CDX-confirmed raw Apple DocC payload after Beta 1 and before Beta 2. This is initial snapshot-state attribution, not a claim about the exact hour the item first appeared.

changes.title: Feedback close-button known issue
changes.canonicalSummary: The Feedback interface could leave its close button unresponsive after a crash or panic report was submitted.
changes.summary: The initial beta note records an unresponsive close control after submitting a crash or panic report, with locking and unlocking as a workaround.
changes.verificationMethod: Observed in the first CDX-confirmed raw Apple DocC payload after Beta 1 and before Beta 2. This is initial snapshot-state attribution, not a claim about the exact hour the item first appeared.

changes.title: Full Memory Integrity Enforcement opt-in
changes.canonicalSummary: Applications gained an option to use the full Memory Integrity Enforcement protection level instead of being limited to Soft Mode.
changes.summary: The archived beta note says applications can opt in to the full protection mode for stronger memory-safety enforcement.
changes.verificationMethod: Observed in the first CDX-confirmed raw Apple DocC payload after Beta 1 and before Beta 2. This is initial snapshot-state attribution, not a claim about the exact hour the item first appeared.

citations.locator: Memory Integrity Enforcement for Applications — New Features; issue 160719439

changes.title: RCS end-to-end encryption testing between Apple devices
changes.canonicalSummary: The beta exposed RCS end-to-end encryption for developer testing between supported Apple devices while explicitly withholding it from the public release.
changes.summary: Apple's initial beta note limits this RCS encryption test to Apple-device conversations and says it was not shipping to customers in 26.4.
changes.verificationMethod: Observed in the first CDX-confirmed raw Apple DocC payload after Beta 1 and before Beta 2. This is initial snapshot-state attribution, not a claim about the exact hour the item first appeared.

changes.title: PAC configuration run-loop source leak fix
changes.canonicalSummary: CFNetwork corrected a run-loop source leak affecting processes that used automatic proxy configuration or discovery.
changes.summary: The beta note documents corrected ownership behavior around proxy auto-configuration callbacks and their returned Core Foundation objects.
changes.verificationMethod: Observed in the first CDX-confirmed raw Apple DocC payload after Beta 1 and before Beta 2. This is initial snapshot-state attribution, not a claim about the exact hour the item first appeared.

citations.locator: Networking — Resolved Issues; issues 166839810 and FB21376045

changes.title: Reality Composer export known issue
changes.canonicalSummary: Reality Composer could present an empty export panel instead of exporting a project as Reality or USDZ content.
changes.summary: The archived note records an empty export menu that prevented Reality Composer projects from being exported in the documented formats.
changes.verificationMethod: Observed in the first CDX-confirmed raw Apple DocC payload after Beta 1 and before Beta 2. This is initial snapshot-state attribution, not a claim about the exact hour the item first appeared.

changes.title: StoreKit transaction revocation fields
changes.canonicalSummary: StoreKit Transaction records gained revocationType and revocationPercentage fields.
changes.summary: The initial beta note adds two revocation-related properties to StoreKit transaction data.
changes.verificationMethod: Observed in the first CDX-confirmed raw Apple DocC payload after Beta 1 and before Beta 2. This is initial snapshot-state attribution, not a claim about the exact hour the item first appeared.

changes.title: SwiftUI current user-activity fix
changes.canonicalSummary: SwiftUI corrected a failure to expose the most recent userActivity value as the current user activity.
changes.summary: The archived beta note marks SwiftUI's stale current-user-activity behavior as resolved.
changes.verificationMethod: Observed in the first CDX-confirmed raw Apple DocC payload after Beta 1 and before Beta 2. This is initial snapshot-state attribution, not a claim about the exact hour the item first appeared.

changes.title: SwiftUI RealityKit animation-grouping limitation
changes.canonicalSummary: Implicit RealityKit component animations combine only when successive animations target the same property set.
changes.summary: Apple documents that overlapping implicit animations can remain independent and overwrite a property when their targeted component-property sets differ.
changes.verificationMethod: Observed in the first CDX-confirmed raw Apple DocC payload after Beta 1 and before Beta 2. This is initial snapshot-state attribution, not a claim about the exact hour the item first appeared.

changes.title: UIKit keyboard-notification delivery fix
changes.canonicalSummary: UIKit corrected a case in which KeyboardNotification might not be delivered.
changes.summary: The initial beta note marks unreliable keyboard-notification delivery as fixed.
changes.verificationMethod: Observed in the first CDX-confirmed raw Apple DocC payload after Beta 1 and before Beta 2. This is initial snapshot-state attribution, not a claim about the exact hour the item first appeared.

blocks.text: Archived Apple note state

Apple's human documentation shell was archived on the Beta 1 date, and its raw DocC payload was captured the following day, before Beta 2. The payload identifies itself as macOS Tahoe 26.4 Beta Release Notes and contains 18 structured items represented here.

citations.locator: Human DocC capture 20260216203520; companion raw payload 20260217150536; macOS Tahoe 26.4 Beta Release Notes

blocks.text: Documented Beta 1 inventory

The initial state spans AppKit, Background Assets, CoreMIDI, external boot and media, Exchange accounts, login and Recovery, networking, resource forks, Rosetta, StoreKit, SwiftUI, and virtualization. Known issues remain labeled separately from fixes and new capabilities.

blocks.text: Attribution boundary

This is an observed initial snapshot state rather than a claim that every item appeared at the exact release hour. Because the raw payload follows Beta 1 and precedes Beta 2, no later milestone is crossed and no final-note material is projected backward.

changes.verificationMethod: Observed in the first CDX-confirmed raw Apple DocC payload after Beta 1 and before Beta 2. This is initial snapshot-state attribution, not a claim about the exact hour the item first appeared.

changes.title: Network MIDI 2.0 support
changes.canonicalSummary: macOS expanded networked music-device communication with MIDI 2.0 capabilities.

changes.verificationMethod: Observed in the first CDX-confirmed raw Apple DocC payload after Beta 1 and before Beta 2. This is initial snapshot-state attribution, not a claim about the exact hour the item first appeared.

changes.title: M1 external-boot panic known issue
changes.canonicalSummary: Some M1 Mac configurations could panic while booting an installation from an external disk.
changes.summary: Apple documents an external-disk boot panic on some M1 configurations and recommends a secondary APFS volume for testing.
changes.verificationMethod: Observed in the first CDX-confirmed raw Apple DocC payload after Beta 1 and before Beta 2. This is initial snapshot-state attribution, not a claim about the exact hour the item first appeared.

changes.verificationMethod: Observed in the first CDX-confirmed raw Apple DocC payload after Beta 1 and before Beta 2. This is initial snapshot-state attribution, not a claim about the exact hour the item first appeared.

changes.title: Exchange account synchronization known issue
changes.canonicalSummary: Exchange synchronization could fail for Calendar, Reminders, and Notes.
changes.summary: Apple documents failed Exchange synchronization and suggests disabling Notes sync to keep Calendar and Reminders updating.
changes.verificationMethod: Observed in the first CDX-confirmed raw Apple DocC payload after Beta 1 and before Beta 2. This is initial snapshot-state attribution, not a claim about the exact hour the item first appeared.

changes.title: Standard-user Touch ID unlock known issue
changes.canonicalSummary: Touch ID might be unavailable for unlocking a standard user's screen after an update when FileVault and login order meet the documented conditions.

changes.verificationMethod: Observed in the first CDX-confirmed raw Apple DocC payload after Beta 1 and before Beta 2. This is initial snapshot-state attribution, not a claim about the exact hour the item first appeared.

changes.verificationMethod: Observed in the first CDX-confirmed raw Apple DocC payload after Beta 1 and before Beta 2. This is initial snapshot-state attribution, not a claim about the exact hour the item first appeared.
